title: Threads: replies to a message
spec: Request 16 Reply { room, parent, text } (answered as Post) and push 71 Threaded { room, cursor of the reply, parent }, announced by FEATURE_THREADS (8). DurableServer::reply accepts only a parent that is a live, top-level message held in the room (NoParent, E_NO_SUCH_MESSAGE, for a reply, a missing or deleted message), posts as post would (search finds it), and records it with its parent in one journal record (Op::Reply, tag 18) that survives a restart; parent_of and reply_count read the threads. After a Sync, a reply's Threaded push follows its Posted push only on a connection that agreed to FEATURE_THREADS. The client's inbox keeps each reply's parent (RoomView::parents) without moving the cursor. The network server advertises FEATURE_THREADS.
